name: exodium
description: Cross-platform launcher for the eXoDOS collections

scripts.init-dev: bash scripts/get-dosbox.sh && bash scripts/get-emulators.sh && bash scripts/init-dev.sh
scripts.gen-db: cd src-tauri && cargo run --example generate_db && cd .. && gzip -kf metadata/exodium.db
scripts.infohash: sqlite3 "${EXODIUM_DB:-$HOME/Library/Application Support/com.redfox.exodium/exodium.db}" "SELECT key, value FROM config WHERE key LIKE '%infohash%';"
